info.name: EcommerceApp API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the EcommerceApp — .NET 8 + PostgreSQL + Razorpay.

**Base URL**: `{{baseUrl}}` (default `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`)

**Auth**: JWT Bearer. Run `Auth / Login` first — the token is auto-saved to `{{token}}` by the collection test script.

**Roles**: Guest (anonymous), Customer, SuperAdmin.

item.name: Forgot Password (sends a 6-digit code by email)
Verify Reset OTP (returns the single-use reset token)
